headline: The 'G'ishtko'prik' checkpoint on the border with Kazakhstan will open on November 25 at 16:00
summary: The Gishtkoprik customs post on the Uzbekistan-Kazakhstan border will reopen at 16:00 on November 25, the Customs Committee said. The crossing closed in February 2025 and has been modernised in stages.
why: Border crossings govern the flow of trade and freight between Central Asian economies, so reopening affects transport costs and cross-border commerce.
original_headline: Qozog‘iston bilan chegaradagi “G‘ishtko‘prik” o‘tkazish punkti 25-noyabr soat 16:00 dan ochiladi
